scope: Only frames with actual page replacement enter shiftedCpu/Gpu statistics. GPU stream interval includes descriptor rebinding, resident static metadata reset, reset wind/geometry and immediate pool/handoff selection. Advance interval includes full solving and display, and is not an isolated solver measurement.
shutdown: 720 timestamp samples and 68 shift events were saved and validated. The independent native timing process hung during Unity shutdown and was terminated after verifying its exact temporary project and executeMethod. No user Unity process was terminated. Functional and regression runners exited normally.
caveat: Keep all long samples: GPU maximum was 7.186432ms. Concurrent Unity processes were left running. These are elapsed timestamp intervals, not a worst-case guarantee or evidence for the 1ms XPBD target.
